Name: Fizz Girl Portraits by Bucket
Author: MrsTNT69
Description:
I wanted to add a weird girl to the game, and Fizz was the perfect base — so she’s now a girl, keeping all her strange vibes.
She’s still the same Fizz, just in her little gender-transition arc and honestly glowing with joy. Hope you like her!

Maybe in the future I can add more variants or outfits for them. For now, [b][i]Enjoy[/i]!![/b]

Manifest.Name: Fizz Girl Portrait
Manifest.Description: Reimagined Fizz as a girl — Without changing her personality or vibes.
